pages.title: Judgments
pages.note: The Supreme Court is on its Dussehra break, and no judgment pronounced in this window was reported by the legal publications we track. Reports on 22 October about the Pinarayi Vijayan stay (order of 21 October) and the DSSSB transgender-posts case (order of 16 October) concern earlier orders and are left out.

items.caseName: Mahesh Chandra Joshi v. State of Rajasthan
items.headline: Long pre-trial custody can't become punishment
items.text: Bail for two accused in the Jal Jeevan Mission tender case; probe is over and chargesheets filed, so further jail isn't needed.
items.why: Seriousness of allegations alone cannot justify indefinite detention before trial.

items.caseName: Shailendra Singh v. Election Commission of India & 2 Ors.
items.coram: Alok Mathur, Abdhesh Kumar Chaudhary, JJ.
items.headline: ECI assures videography of UP MLC polling
items.text: Plea for continuous videography in Lucknow graduates' seat disposed of after ECI promised to follow its handbook.

items.caseName: Aakash Narayan v. Dr. Shakuntala Misra National Rehabilitation University
items.headline: JEST score can't be forced on PhD admissions
items.text: A university that follows UGC-NET criteria can't be made to accept a JEST score; petition dismissed.

items.caseName: Bipin Satish Chandra Agrwal v. State of Maharashtra
items.headline: ₹5 lakh for illegal arrest; action on police
items.text: Arrest and remand held unlawful; ₹5 lakh in 2 weeks, police officers to be suspended, magistrates' role sent to admin committee.

items.caseName: Maulana Halimullah Farooque Ahemed Khan v. State of Maharashtra
items.coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, CJ, Advait Sethna, J.
items.headline: Fresh plea allowed against anti-conversion law
items.text: Challenge to the Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Act, 2026 withdrawn with liberty to file a fuller petition.

items.caseName: Jan Seva Welfare Society (Regd.) v. Union of India & Ors.
items.coram: Nitin Wasudeo Sambre, ACJ, Sanjay Sharma, J.
items.headline: Clean public toilets are part of right to life
items.text: Court proposed surprise inspections of MCD toilets by social work students, reporting to an Additional Commissioner.

items.headline: No stay on 'Doosra' on Sourav Ganguly's plea
items.text: No urgent interim order against the film's 23 Oct release; personality rights suit kept for the next day.

items.caseName: Nandinee Das v. State of Assam & Ors.
items.headline: JJBs to find children held in adult jails
items.text: Assam's Juvenile Justice Boards must inspect prisons by 31 Oct, shift any children to proper homes and visit jails regularly.

items.caseName: XYZ Victim v. State of Gujarat & Anr.
items.coram: Ilesh J. Vora, R.T. Vachhani, JJ.
items.headline: Live-in pacts undercut false-promise rape case
items.text: Acquittal upheld; written live-in agreements recording consent made the false-promise-of-marriage charge hard to sustain.

items.caseName: Rouf Ahmad Wani v. UT of J&K & Ors.
items.headline: Vague 'anti-social' tag can't justify detention
items.text: PSA detention quashed: no specifics showing a threat to public order, stale cases and unexplained delay in execution.

items.caseName: Tariq Ahmad Dar v. UT of J&K
items.headline: Serial livestock theft can disturb public order
items.text: PSA detention upheld for a man linked to 11 cattle-theft FIRs; pending cases don't bar preventive detention.

items.caseName: Jahangir Iqbal Ganai v. Md Amin Dar & Ors.
items.headline: Costs on senior advocate set aside
items.text: Tribunal's ₹10,000 costs quashed for lack of hearing; Bar and Bench urged to show restraint after heated exchanges.

items.headline: Slight penetration is penetrative assault
items.text: POCSO conviction for aggravated penetrative sexual assault upheld; act was not mere 'touching' under S.7.

items.caseName: Mohammed Shameer Ali v. State of Kerala & Ors.
items.headline: Stalled probe since 2019: FIR quashed
items.text: Delay alone isn't enough, but inordinate delay not caused by the accused can breach Art. 21; FIR quashed.

items.coram: Subodh Abhyankar, Jai Kumar Pillai, JJ.
items.headline: Spouse's consent can't lock a man in rehab
items.text: Detention at a private de-addiction centre on the wife's form alone held illegal under Art. 21; release ordered.

items.headline: Conjugal-rights plea no ground to quash FIR
items.text: Husband's plea to quash wife's cruelty FIR dismissed; FIR quashed for in-laws with no specific allegations.

items.caseName: Shamina Naaz & Anr. v. Rimsha Taashfeen & Anr.
items.headline: Muslim mother can be named property guardian
items.text: Court may appoint her under the Guardians and Wards Act and allow a guarded sale of the minor's share.

items.coram: Munnuri Laxman, Yogendra Kumar Purohit, JJ.
items.headline: Long refusal of intimacy is mental cruelty
items.text: Divorce upheld: wife's prolonged refusal without valid reason, with suicide threats, is cruelty under S.13(1)(ia) HMA.
